candidates.change_summary: Change function to return false immediately if any external call succeeds instead of reverting on failure (inverts success handling and return value).
Remove the revert on failed external call; treat any failed call as a non-fatal event and continue, returning true at end (thus returning true where original would revert).
Return the success flag of the last external call instead of always returning true; if no calls made returns true (changes observable return value).

Change the calldata selector used in external call from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256), altering which external function is invoked and thus potentially changing observed effects.
Remove the revert on failed external call and instead continue, so failures of called contracts no longer revert this function, changing observable state after return.
Change loop to iterate from end to start (reverse order), altering the sequence of external calls and thus possibly changing final observable effects.
